card.name: Word starts before a paired or unit term
card.fires_on: Short words or word parts that sit just before an expected completion, such as a weight unit after a number (kg, lb, lbs) or sex after 'age and'. Also seen on 'under' in 'preferably under continuous care'.

modes.label: Weight units after a number
modes.description: Weight units such as kg, lb or lbs right after a number in dosing-by-weight tables.

modes.label: Age-and-sex pairing
modes.description: The word sex after 'age and' in comparisons with matched populations.
modes.example: compared to pediatric patients of the same age and<< sex>>, on average

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: A modifier or word start inside a phrase, such as under before 'continuous hospital care' or yellow in a tablet colour list.

card.plain: It fires on small words or units in the middle of a phrase, mostly weight units after a number and 'sex' after 'age and'.
